items.context: @rektfencer (347.372 seguidores), en inglés: afirma que el piso de Bitcoin ya está y que "vamos más arriba desde aquí", con gráfico. Post de ~35 min con 26 likes, 9 respuestas y 8658 vistas. Ángulo: índice Market Temperature (de 99,29 a 0,67 en 364 días; MVRV, media de 200 semanas, caída desde el máximo y momentum de 90 días, 25% cada uno).
items.suggested_text:
Bottoms are usually only obvious in hindsight, but the conditions behind them can be measured.

I track a Market Temperature index that blends MVRV, price vs the 200-week average, drawdown from the high and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, 25% each. It went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days. Readings that cold have historically lined up with the zones where long-term risk/reward was best, not with the exact low.

Cold can stay cold for a while, though. The part the index can't tell you is whether this is the floor or just the start of a long accumulation range.
